def reg(f):
    L=f.ascii.split('\n')
    def bb(ch,rmin=18):
        pts=[(rr,c) for rr in range(rmin,64) for c,ch2 in enumerate(L[rr]) if ch2==ch]

    return {'gray':bb('g'),'purple':bb('p'),'white':bb('W')}
print('after SPACE', reg(current_frame))

    L=f.ascii.split('\n')
